Docs.summary: Tokens that aren't image tokens: the query and text items (including the query instruction) and the short prompt the model adds around each image. Equal to `promptTokens` minus `visualTokens`, so text and image tokens can be priced separately. Omitted when the split isn't known: `promptTokens` isn't reported, or the request has images and `visualTokens` isn't reported.
